methodological_evidence.causal_use_constraint: AFRY mechanisms may define hypotheses, benchmark diagnostics and stress axes; they are not identified causal effects or empirical validation.
material_model_risks: endogenous economic build and retirement assumptions
policy and bidder-behaviour assumptions near zero and negative prices
representative weather-pattern selection without authorized probabilities
economic curtailment excluding local grid and technical curtailment

High.interpretation: commodity and price upside around Central structural demand and capacity

Central.interpretation: vendor central market scenario with broad net-zero alignment claim

Low.interpretation: slower decarbonisation with lower aggregate demand
must_not_be_mapped_to: slow FMV scenario without an approved crosswalk

Delayed Transition.interpretation: slower heat electrification and emissions abatement under a distinct transition storyline

weather_semantics.interpretation: conditional physical weather patterns used by BID3, not delivery-calendar timestamps
weather_semantics.vendor_aggregation: five-pattern average and range where documented

public_target.scope: domestic electricity production from renewable energy excluding hydropower
public_target.source: Swiss Federal Office of Energy monitoring / Energy Act Article 2

swiss_policy_crosswalk.ep2050_plus_status: official but no longer adequate for all recent energy-sector developments
swiss_policy_crosswalk.challenge: AFRY's policy-alignment wording does not demonstrate compliance with the binding 2035 target, and High does not span a faster Swiss renewable build-out.
required_reconciliation: renewable fractions of waste, biomass, Other Res and Other Thermal
policy cut-off and assumed compliance path

prohibited_uses: infer UTC, DST or leap timestamps from representative hours
infer 15-minute shapes from hourly AFRY output alone
publish raw or derived vendor values to Git or RAG
